name: codex-sci-ppt
description: Create and rebuild scientific figures as editable PowerPoint graphics.

interface.longDescription: Codex Sci-PPT creates scientific schematics from structured scene descriptions and locally reconstructs suitable raster diagrams into editable PowerPoint objects without a third-party credit system.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Codex Sci-PPT to create or rebuild my scientific figure as editable PowerPoint objects.
